rubrics.justification: The response identifies a blastocyst with visible zona and some asymmetry, but it over-interprets the image by asserting vacuolation, intracavitary debris, and degenerative TE changes that are not clearly discernible from this single image; downgrading to 3BB/3BC is not well supported.

It integrates most relevant factors well, including young age, ovarian reserve, prior live birth, sperm parameters, day-5 transfer, and endometrial thickness, though some lifestyle and fertilization-rate interpretations are overstated.

The structure is logical and the probability estimate is tied to listed factors, but several deductions are weakly supported, especially the morphology downgrade and the weighting of minor lifestyle factors and prior biochemical pregnancy.

Some elements are aligned with standard IVF practice, but recommending aspirin, ERA, thrombophilia/NK-cell workup, and strongly recommending PGT-A after only a biochemical pregnancy/live birth history is not well supported by major guidelines for this profile.

The response gives concrete next steps such as re-review of embryo grading, luteal support confirmation, and future-cycle considerations, though several recommendations are more speculative than guideline-driven.
